name: ai-text-detection-benchmark
description: A dataset and benchmark for detecting AI-generated (machine-written) text across multiple generation models and prompts. It measures a model's ability to distinguish human-written from machine-generated text under varied domains, lengths, and generation settings. The benchmark supports automated metrics and stress tests (e.g., paraphrasing or style transfer) to evaluate robustness.
evaluation_method: Accuracy / F1 and AUROC (detection metrics); robustness evaluated via accuracy drop under transformations
typical_sota_score: ≈70–95% (varies widely by generator, prompt, and test conditions)
reputation: Moderately used by the synthetic-text detection community on Hugging Face and by researchers benchmarking detector robustness.
